title: AC Milan Circle Bruno Fernandes, but Patience Should Rule
body:
AC Milan are monitoring Manchester United midfielder Bruno Fernandes [S1]. The same BBC Sport gossip column also said Arsenal's pair have yet to start talks on new deals, and that Trabzonspor have renewed interest in Tottenham forward Richarlison [S1].

Another BBC Sport round-up flagged Manchester United target Calvin Bassey of Fulham, with Brentford's Nathan Collins also on their list [S2]. It also reported that AC Milan want Real Madrid's Endrick on loan [S2].

A side leaking goals at that rate should be fixing its back line before it goes shopping for glamour names.

The smart money is on patience.

Talk is cheap until the paperwork is signed, so treat every rumour with care.

The Touchline Take: judge the business when the window shuts, not before.
